state_crossings.place: Blaine Pacific Highway (Pacific Highway POE) on Hwy 15
state_crossings.source: International border on the continuous Pacific Highway truck path; position approximate from public POE coordinates matched to Valhalla geometry (development-time).

corridor.source: Development-time public Valhalla auto-profile geometry over OpenStreetMap (valhalla1.openstreetmap.de), sampled 2026-09-22, along Hwy 15 / Pacific Highway. Paid miles kept at 16. Public FOSSGIS Valhalla truck costing is NOT adopted here: unconstrained truck returned ~40.5 mi (vs ~14–16 on the commercial Pacific Highway path). Named HGV honesty debt until a regional BC/WA truck bake (ask before Josh overnight).

speed_limits.source: Coarse Hwy 15 / Pacific Highway urban approach default; CA statutory truck caps still unresearched (named units debt). Not an OSM maxspeed:hgv harvest.
